# Clipper2

Unmodified C# sources from Angus Johnson's **Clipper2_2.0.1** release, downloaded from https://github.com/AngusJohnson/Clipper2/tree/Clipper2_2.0.1/CSharp/Clipper2Lib on 2026-09-05. Boost Software License 1.0 is preserved in LICENSE.txt and source headers. Approximately 275 KiB of source, no binary/runtime dependency. The Unity assembly definition is local packaging; it compiles only in the Editor. Polygon operations use district-local coordinates at millimetre precision. No package or engine upgrades were made.
